Implemented papers_thermal.py and qualified Fig. 2(a,c) of Studying thermal radiation with T matrices, Phys. Rev. B 112, 054307 (2025).

  • 300 frequencies, 600 author angular values, 52 upstream comparisons, 22 convergence checks.
  • Maximum author-spectrum discrepancy 0.576654%, within the explicitly documented 1% qualification threshold.
  • Angular agreement 2.17×10⁻⁷ relative; axial/helicity symmetry 1.56×10⁻¹⁴.
  • Degree-10 versus higher-degree discrepancy ≤0.05695%. Absorption remains nonnegative.
  • This uncovered the ill-conditioned cluster solve fixed by /root/conditioning.

Results, pinned author fixtures, inspected plot, SVG. Ruff passed. No commits or sync.

Final-build rerun required: results identify native 8977cad…; another agent installed bde010c… during this run. Reproduce after source freeze:

PYTHONPATH=python OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 \
uvx --from uv==0.12.3 uv run --no-sync python scripts/papers_thermal.py \
  --samples 300 --convergence \
  --upstream-reference benchmarks/papers/thermal-upstream-comparison.json

Author source: ec710fc1…. Final report includes native, Python-source, script and fixture hashes plus environment versions.
